memory_candidates.insight: When nine case-pairs of a symmetric natAbs-bounded goal arise from destructuring the same trichotomy twice, the three mirror pairs need no separate argument: omega treats Int.natAbs symmetrically in its two sides, so applying the symmetric source lemma (here pinCompat_of_ladderPath) with its two arguments swapped discharges the mirrored goal directly. Nine branches, six distinct arguments.

Destructuring a trichotomy disjunct of the form `x = u` with `rcases ... with <rfl, h>` substitutes u away and silently breaks every later reference to u's own hypotheses (hu0/hu1). Bind the equation as a named hypothesis instead and let omega consume it; the arithmetic closes identically and the u-indexed hypotheses stay usable.
